messages:
sophie: :rotating_light: Root: Observed inconsistent model versions being served from API Gateway routes in eu-central-1. First reports at ~02:10 UTC — some requests hit v2.1.4 while traffic intended for v2.2.0 returned increased latency and rare 502s. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2125000000

alert-bot: Detector: config-propagation-delay > 120s across 3 gateway clusters. 15% of edge nodes reported stale route config. Paging @marco and @leah.

marco: Quick triage: config push for the v2.2 rollout partially failed during a control-plane leader handover. Some gateway nodes did not receive the new route->backend mappings and continued routing to older model endpoints. That mismatch caused unexpected model-interface differences and occasional 502s when downstream model-side headers were missing.

leah: Mitigations applied at 02:18 UTC: 1) paused further rollout of v2.2, 2) forced a reconciliation on all eu-central gateways, 3) added a temporary traffic-shift to route all traffic to verified v2.1.4 until we validate v2.2 pushes.

sophie: Impact: customers using canary routes or new V2 features in eu-central may see increased latency and sporadic errors for ~8-12 minutes. Approximately 9 customers flagged degraded responses. No data loss; behavior is routing/config-driven.

kiran: Monitoring: after reconciliation, stale-node count fell to 0 within 6 minutes. Error rate on gateway dropped from 0.9% -> 0.05%. Canary checks for v2.2 show header parity failures; we will not resume rollout until fixed.

marco: Ops commands used (internal):

```
# force reconciliation on gateways in eu-central
kubectl -n control-plane exec deploy/config-controller -- /app/reconcile --region eu-central-1 --wait
# list nodes with stale config
curl -sS https://internal-api.redwood.ai/gateway/status?region=eu-central-1 | jq '.nodes | map(select(.config_age>120))'
```

leah: Customer comms draft: "We experienced a partial config propagation issue in eu-central during a model rollout that caused inconsistent routing and transient errors for some customers. We rolled back the rollout and reconciled gateway configs; services have returned to normal. We will follow up with a postmortem and timeline for re-rollout." Ready to send to impacted accounts after 30m stability.

db-sre: Root cause action items: 1) harden control-plane leader handover to avoid dropped pushes, 2) add config-push ack tracking and per-node alerting, 3) add an automated pre-check that compares route hashes before switching canary percentage. Postmortem owners: @marco (control-plane) and @leah (rollout/process). ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.

tim: Noted impacted customers: CUST-210, CUST-412. CS notified at 02:25 UTC. Please escalate if any tickets come in.

alert-bot: Severity downgraded to S3 at 02:30 UTC. Monitoring active.

sophie: Thanks team — keep monitoring and do not re-enable the v2.2 rollout until we complete the preflight fixes. End of broadcast. :white_check_mark:
